deeds.prompt: Premium hand-painted classic-fantasy MMORPG achievement crest: a single round medallion emblem, centered, filling most of the square, on a flat pure white background with nothing else. A dark bronze ring frames a leather druid pauldron wrapped in living bramble, thorns curling into a carved root knot at the collar, moss green and bark brown on charcoal inside the ring. No text, no writing, no watermark, no frame outside the medallion, no drop shadow onto the white.
